notes: BITESToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named BITES with symbol BITES and 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints all 10,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the launch factory. It has no later minting, transfer fees, owner or privileged controls. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
